title: A Midsummer Night's Dream: Puck's Tricks

dialogue_script.speaker: Narrator
dialogue_script.text: In Ancient Greece there is a girl named Hermia who loves a young man Lysander. However, her father says she must marry Demetrius but she does not want to. She and Lysander escape to a forest. Helena is Hermia’s friend and loves Demetrius. Helena and Demetrius also run away to the forest. Soon, they get tired and they fall asleep under the trees. In the forest, there is Nick Bottom, an actor and his group, who are putting on a play. Farther through the forest the queen of fairies Titania is arguing with her husband, Oberon who is very angry with her. So, he sends Puck, the playful sprite, to bring the juice from the love flower to make her love him again.

dialogue_script.speaker: Puck
dialogue_script.text: Ha, ha! I’ll play a trick on all these people! I’ll turn this man to a donkey. Abracadabra! You, Nick Bottom, are a donkey!

dialogue_script.speaker: Oberon
dialogue_script.text: Give me the magic juice. I’ll put some of it in Titania’s eyes myself. When she wakes up, she will fall in love with the first one she sees. This will be me.

dialogue_script.speaker: Titania
dialogue_script.text: Where am I? Oh, my love! Who are you? You are so handsome!

dialogue_script.speaker: Titania
dialogue_script.text: Where are you going my love! Come back to me!

dialogue_script.speaker: Puck
dialogue_script.text: Ha, ha, ha! Let me put some flower juice in Lysander’s eyes now.

dialogue_script.speaker: Lysander
dialogue_script.text: Oh, I am desperately in love with you! How beautiful you are!

dialogue_script.speaker: Helena
dialogue_script.text: What’s wrong with you? Don’t you love Hermia any longer?

dialogue_script.speaker: Lysander
dialogue_script.text: Hermia? Who is she? You are my love!

dialogue_script.speaker: Puck
dialogue_script.text: Ha, ha, ha! Let me put some flower juice in Demetrius’ eyes now.

dialogue_script.speaker: Demetrius
dialogue_script.text: Oh, my darling Hermia! You are the prettiest girl in the world. I love you deeply and truly!

dialogue_script.speaker: Hermia
dialogue_script.text: Oh, where is Lysander? Why isn’t he with me? He is my true love!

dialogue_script.speaker: Oberon
dialogue_script.text: Come here Puck! Put everything back to normal.

dialogue_script.speaker: Puck
dialogue_script.text: All the play is just a dream! Everything that happens on a midsummer night in a magic forest is a dream.
